task: ADR-033 (Procurement Management Plan Standard): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Tier 3 procurement contract depending on Scope and Cost, not on Resource: make-or-buy criteria, a dependency intake record, supplier selection, contract and licence checks, and an exit path. One shared logit map; the deciding role (procurement or project manager) is recorded with each pair. Floors and caps stay at the ADR-012 defaults. Acquisitions that exceed the Cost envelope go through change control.
Three alternatives rejected: ad hoc library choices, treating procurement as a section of Cost, and banning all external services.
Names justified, costed dependencies with exit paths, and the cost: the intake record adds friction to adopting a library.
Section 8 clarifies the authorization threshold by example (10 percent of stage contingency), defers the pyproject.toml audit, and resolves the DAG as scope plus cost. Domain re-basing stays open.
